explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/94: 'Erdős and Fishburn also make the stronger conjecture that Σ f(u_i)² is maximal for the regular n-gon (for large enough n).' The Lean statement: for all sufficiently large n, every n-point set P ⊂ ℝ² in convex position (ConvexIndep) has Σ f(u)² at most the corresponding sum for regularNGon n, the n-th roots of unity on the unit circle (n distinct points; the sum is scale-invariant). Faithful.
